title: Samsung watches
body: Hello everyone. It has been a while. Always thank you for the hard work. I was wondering if there is the hope to implement natively Samsung watches support. I noticed that currently the watch support has increased a lot but still no Samsung. Any hope for some of you guys to find an option??? After all Samsung watches are very popular. Thanks

comments.body:
Have you checked out Juraj Attal's G-Watch Service?  It depends on a
service companion app on your phone, but currently can show xdrip data and
AAPS data on the watch face including carbs, IOB, basal, and pump data.

I'm not sure he's received enough feedback from community, currently it
simply displays information, it cannot send pump commands like the WatchOS
watchfaces can, but perhaps with some feedback he may be willing to
incorporate.

Currently use it with my Galaxy Watch Active 2 and it works.

I thought I saw a #tizen-dev channel on discord, but it no longer seems to
be there.

![Screen_20201017_134410](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1902827/96353328-bd6f2180-107f-11eb-8488-fcedeb66990f.png)
